column1: # Three speakers with frequent backchannels and overlapping turns.

column3: So the plan is to move the whole office to the new building over one weekend.
We'll pack on Friday afternoon, the movers come Saturday morning, and we set up the desks on Sunday.
The servers move separately, a week earlier.
That sounds tight, but I think it can work if everyone labels their boxes clearly.
And we should keep a list of anything that breaks.
One last question. Is parking included at the new building, or do we need permits?
Parking is included for the first year.
